group.label: General
group.comment: Connects this store to your Arasta account. The chat widget appears once the Store ID is filled in.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: When set to No, the widget is not loaded, no identity tokens are issued and orders are not linked to conversations.

group.label: Widget
group.comment: Both values are in the embed code in the Arasta dashboard: Stores > your store > Widget.

field.label: Widget Loader URL
field.comment: The src of the script in your Arasta embed code. Leave the default unless Arasta gives you a different address. Order links are sent to the same host.

field.label: Store ID
field.comment: The data-store-id value of your Arasta embed code. Use a different ID per store view if each one is a separate Arasta store.

group.label: Customer Identity and Order Links
group.comment: With a signing secret, the widget recognises signed-in customers (signed token, never stored in cached pages) and orders placed after a chat are linked to the conversation. Without it, customers chat as guests and orders are not linked.

field.label: Signing Secret
field.comment: From the Arasta dashboard (Stores > your store > Widget). At least 32 characters. Stored encrypted.

field.label: Identity Token Lifetime (seconds)
field.comment: How long a signed customer token stays valid: 60 to 3600 seconds. A fresh token is issued when it expires.
